title: Lighthouse with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sky glow behind -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='18' fill='#1a1a4e'/>
  <!-- Light beams -->
  <polygon points='38,22 10,10 15,28' fill='#ffe66d' opacity='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='62,22 90,10 85,28' fill='#ffe66d' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Lighthouse body (tapered tower) -->
  <polygon points='38,36 62,36 68,85 32,85' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- Red stripes -->
  <polygon points='36.5,44 63.5,44 64.5,54 35.5,54' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <polygon points='34,64 66,64 66.8,74 33.2,74' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- Body edge shading -->
  <polygon points='38,36 42,36 42,85 32,85' fill='#d9d9d9'/>
  <!-- Lighthouse top room / lantern -->
  <rect x='36' y='26' width='28' height='12' rx='2' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- Lantern window -->
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <rect x='52' y='28' width='8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <!-- Lantern glow in windows -->
  <rect x='41' y='29' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <rect x='53' y='29' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  <!-- Roof dome -->
  <path d='M34,26 Q50,10 66,26 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M34,26 Q50,12 66,26' fill='none' stroke='#ff8095' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Ball on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='3' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on body -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#2b2b6e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#2b2b6e'/>
  <!-- Eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43,52 Q50,59 57,52' fill='none' stroke='#2b2b6e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='46' y='72' width='8' height='13' rx='3' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <rect x='47' y='73' width='6' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a0714f'/>
  <!-- Door knob -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='79' r='1' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <!-- Base / rock -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#6b7c93'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='20' ry='3' fill='#8494a8'/>
  <!-- Small waves -->
  <path d='M14,90 Q20,86 26,90 Q32,94 38,90' fill='none' stroke='#5bc0eb' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62,92 Q68,88 74,92 Q80,96 86,92' fill='none' stroke='#5bc0eb' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stars -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='14' r='1.5' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='8' r='1' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='6' r='1' fill='#ffe66d'/>
</svg>
